canonical_ledger_summary.scope: Non-transactional supplied accounting; observed labels are user assertions, not authenticated receipts. Customer savings are not revenue. No funds, authority or capability improvement are created.

cash_flow.equation: B_t = B_previous + actual_collections + external_capital - paid_delivery - paid_investment; available = B_t - unpaid_obligations - required_reserves.
cash_flow.investment_execution: No financial transaction or new paid commitment was executed; constructed-capability resource cost remains unknown. A null balance cannot authorize a new commitment.

normalized.interpretation: Algebraic crossing for equal accepted scope; not an observed duration or saving.

prohibitions: No-op checks and benchmark repetitions are not new customer jobs.

A hypothetical positive scenario never changes actual economic admission.

finance.operational_benefit: Assess separately using accepted scope and complete measured resource envelopes.

canonical_unknown_investment.scope: Conditional finite-reuse scenario. Supplied savings are assumptions, not demonstrated improvement; failed construction and maintenance remain costs. No investment is executed.

equations.repayment: Repayment requires B(N) >= 0 with equivalent accepted outcomes and complete attributable costs.
equations.constant_case_threshold: If s-m > 0, N_break_even = ceil(I_complete/(s-m)); otherwise positive I has no finite payoff under that assumption.
equations.acceptance_and_failures: Cost per accepted delivery includes every failed attempt and correction in the numerator.
equations.low_utilization: Recurring cost per accepted delivery = total recurring delivery and shared costs / accepted deliveries; zero accepted output has no finite per-accepted cost.
equations.financing: Available_to_commit = cash - unpaid_obligations - required_reserves; simulated savings or allocations are not collections.

manual_incumbent_status: Actual first manual assembly/probe created inside this study; construction is charged. It is not a measured competent-human, no-AI service baseline.
human_counterfactual_status: Modeled wage-only equivalent-scope threshold; human duration, responsibility, effort and customer price unmeasured.

investment_questions.question: Did the mission enable a useful decision or action?
investment_questions.answer: 6 accepted primary-arm packages among 6 distinct substantive triggers; customer use, paid demand and action completion remain separately unobserved.

investment_questions.question: Were complete delivery economics compelling against equivalent human work and strong practical tools?
investment_questions.answer: Complete inference/construction/delivery prices and matched human duration are unknown. Report accepted scope and physical resources against both practical automated comparators; no commercial superiority follows.

investment_questions.question: What executable capability was created or improved?
investment_questions.answer: One retained source-bound component-compatibility decision and evidence delivery capability; shared conventional custody validation is adopted with attribution.

investment_questions.question: Did fresh subsequent work repay complete incremental investment?
investment_questions.answer: Fresh-work resource differences, if present, do not identify complete construction, inference and maintenance money. Both builders and failed construction remain charged to this finite study account.

investment_questions.question: What productive capacity or available resources resulted?
investment_questions.answer: Distinct accepted outputs are counted by arm. Future monthly capacity, demand, available cash and financeable capacity increase are unknown; earlier completion is not additional eventual output.

investment_questions.question: Which next investment is justified, including adoption, maintenance, preserving reserves or stopping?
investment_questions.answer: Any engineering adoption requires the frozen empirical gate. Monetary expansion remains on HOLD; obtain actual complete cost and approved funds or a real receipt before a paid commitment. Preserving or retiring the capability remains an evidence-based option.

attribution_notes: Resource ownership categories are exclusive; failed attempts remain within their actual builder/shared owner.
The canonical study-investment account is one accounting container, not a customer mission or a second asset.
Documentary and nested observations do not add resource charges on top of an encompassing additive receipt.
Shared discovery/evaluation and both newly constructed builders are included; legacy reuse does not become free new construction.
The canonical reinvestmentBps default is an inert API value, not a selected financing policy or earned allocation.
Unsuccessful or incomplete work retains its resources while contributing no accepted output.
Acceptance/freshness mappings are explicit input assertions tied to evidence; this script does not replace technical validation.
